simulation_semantics.price: Pre-discount USD per unit for this simulation; source production semantics are unverified
simulation_semantics.quantity: Whole units on a transaction detail line; multiple lines may share a basket
simulation_semantics.status_A: Active and eligible in this simulation only; not a production code dictionary
simulation_semantics.promotion_flag: A simulated receipt-level promotion or redemption, not a planned budget
simulation_semantics.planned_spend: USD budget set before the sales week in a separate synthetic source
simulation_semantics.event_timezone: Naive business event timestamps; submission and audit timestamps use UTC
simulation_semantics.reference_mapping: Current-state submitted identity to master identity; no historical versions
simulation_semantics.ground_truth_precision: Evaluation-only floating components rounded to 9 decimal places for cross-platform reproducibility
